$comment: The Automation Worker brand, as signed off on the Claude Design canvas. A brand refresh changes this file first; the brand gate (tests/gates/brand.test.mjs) then checks src/styles/global.css matches it and the colours still pass contrast. Colours used outside the token set must be declared under supporting; a contrast pair with a waiver warns instead of failing.

contrast.use: text on dark header and user bubbles

contrast.note: Was #0B7F75 (4.40). Darkened to #0A766D (4.95) on 23 Nov 2026 (FE-129 OQ-2); the waiver is gone, so the gate fails below 4.5.

supporting.#FBFAF7: chat panel and settings strip (paper, lighter)
supporting.#FFFFFF: chat input, chips and panel surfaces
